no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Cardio Diagnostics is a diagnostics/AI company (not a drug developer). Commercial products are AI-driven genetic-epigenetic diagnostic tests for coronary heart disease (Epi+Gen CHD, PrecisionCHD, HeartRisk) and the CardioInnovate360 platform. The company does not develop therapeutic drugs and therefore has no Phase 1/2/3 drug pipeline.

products.name: Epi+Gen CHD
products.indication: 3-year CHD event risk assessment (5 genetic + 3 epigenetic markers)

products.name: PrecisionCHD
products.indication: Detection of current CHD including INOCA

blockers: Diagnostics-only company — no therapeutic Phase 1/2/3 pipeline.
